style: 1990s retro Japanese anime OVA style, cel-shaded, hand-painted background, dramatic cinematic lighting, deep shadows, rich warm colors, subtle film grain, epic Indian mythology, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

rama.desc: Prince Rama: young man about 25, blue-tinged dark skin, calm compassionate eyes, long black hair tied up, golden crown, yellow silk dhoti, gold armlets, great bow

dasharatha.desc: King Dasharatha: elderly king about 60, fair skin, white beard and moustache, tall jeweled golden crown, red and gold royal robes, pearl necklaces

vasishtha.desc: Sage Vasishtha: very old sage, long white beard and white hair tied in a top knot, saffron robe, rudraksha beads, wooden staff, calm wise face

kausalya.desc: Queen Kausalya: gentle queen about 40, warm brown skin, soft kind face, cream and gold silk sari, small golden crown, long black hair in a braid

kaikeyi.desc: Queen Kaikeyi: striking proud queen about 35, fair skin, sharp eyes, deep red silk sari with gold border, heavy gold jewelry, tall crown

sumitra.desc: Queen Sumitra: serene queen about 38, brown skin, peaceful face, green silk sari with gold border, small golden crown
